name: American Sign Language
notes: Twelve classes: four core courses and eight advanced electives.
ASLA 101 and ASLA 102 should be completed before declaring the major; they are prerequisites, not part of the twelve.

For ASLA 102-106 and 200-level ASLA courses, students must have taken a course conducted entirely in ASL in the immediately preceding semester, or obtain instructor permission. ASLA 106 requires a permission code from the program advisor. Not auto-enforced.
No more than three of the courses taken for the major may be conducted in spoken English - not auto-enforced (the catalog does not record language of instruction).

NEEDS VERIFICATION: the page requires at least 2 literature/culture, 2-3 cultures-language-history, and at least 2 other advanced electives, which accounts for 6-7 of the 8 electives. The remaining 1-2 are modeled as free choice across all three published lists; confirm with the department which list they must come from.
The page writes ASLA 203W and ASLA 205(W); the harvested catalog lists these as ASLA 203 and ASLA 205, which is the form used here.

requirementGroups.label: Core courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Core Courses: ASLA 105: Intermediate American Sign Language I; ASLA 106: Intermediate American Sign Language II; ASLA 203W: Advanced ASLA; ASLA 200: Structure of Signed Languages

requirementGroups.label: ASL literature and culture (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: ASLA Literature and Culture-select at least 2: ASLA 201: Introduction to ASLA Literature; ASLA 202: History and Culture of the American Deaf Community; ASLA 205(W): Art of Translation: ASLA and English; ASLA 250: Sociolinguistics of the American Deaf Community

requirementGroups.label: Cultures, language, and history (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Cultures, Language, and History-select 2-3: ANTH 101; ASLA 208 (BCSC/PSYC 259/LING 208); ASLA 260 (BCSC/PSYC 152/LING 217); LING 110; CLTR 200; CLTR 389; GSWS 105; GSWS 200; GSWS 205; GSWS 296; GSWS 218; HIST 259; HIST 303W; HIST 402; AAAS 207; AAAS 183; PSCI/INTR 267; PSCI/INTR 224; PSCI/INTR 228; RELC 183; PHIL 171; PHIL 247; PHIL 223; PHIL 226
requirementGroups.note: Page says 2-3; the enforced minimum is 2.

requirementGroups.label: Other advanced electives (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Other Advanced Electives-select at least 2: ASLA 110: Comparative Study of French Sign Language; ASLA 113: French Sign Language and Deaf Culture in France; ASLA 204: Theory and Practice of Sign Language Interpreting; ASLA 209: Teaching subjects through ASL; ASLA 222: ASLA Fine Art; ASLA 280: Deaf-Related Careers; BCSC/PSYC 172: Development of Mind and Brain

requirementGroups.label: Remaining advanced electives (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Students are required to complete eight advanced elective courses with at least two courses in the categories of ASLA literature and culture and other advanced electives, and two-three courses in the cultures, language, and history category.
requirementGroups.note: NEEDS VERIFICATION - the published minimums cover 6-7 of the 8 electives; these last 2 are modeled as free choice across all three lists.
